[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:381YE Summer]]
__NOTOC__
<ic>That the Senate grants permission to construct a Trade Hub to Axos in Necropolis. This will trade liao for mana. This ministry will be assigned by the Loyalty assembly. <br><br>
<i>Proposed by Tassato, Seconded by Sarvos.</i></ic>

===Overview===
* This motion is to [[commission]] the construction of a [[ministry|trade hub]] to purchase mana and other materials for liao from [[Axos]].
* Passed

===Date===
* Summer 381YE

===Progress===
* 20 wains of white granite and 5 thrones provided by Tarquinius after Summer Solstice 381YE.
===Campaign Outcome===
* The ministry automatically creates the title of [[Quaymaster of the Black Sails]].
